summary.scope: NFL (32) and MLB (30) clubs; no global/all-sport completeness claim.
summary.methodology: Followed official league club-careers directories to employer pages and designated ATS. Reviewed accessible boards and job descriptions; current listing means a retrievable description with an Apply control and no closure notice. Application submission endpoints were not completed. Some official legacy URLs failed and employer ATS alternatives were used. No-matching-visible means only the accessible extracted board, not proof there are no jobs. Browser/JavaScript-blocked feeds remain explicitly blocked. Salary values are exactly sourced ranges/rates; no estimated salaries included.
portfolio_implications: Build a reproducible public-data ingestion and validation pipeline in SQL/Python.
Expose a decision-oriented scouting, player-evaluation or strategy dashboard; explain assumptions and uncertainty.
Include a predictive model with leakage-aware evaluation and baseline comparison.
Publish readable methodology, tests, data lineage, code and an accessible demo; Dodgers/Royals/Rockies postings explicitly value portfolios or GitHub.
Do not claim professional team impact, proprietary tracking access or hiring guarantees.
limitations: Checked-on date is the user's local date 2026-10-30.
Inventory includes all 62 current club career routes, but 27 routes are blocked or incomplete.
Reviewed routes can also have partial primary-board access; team notes name alternate sources and limitations.
Accessible job descriptions and Apply controls do not guarantee a vacancy remains open at application time.
Some analytics-adjacent coaching/marketing roles are included and labeled accordingly.

jobs.title: Data Analyst Intern
jobs.requirements: Pursuing a quantitative/sports-related bachelor's degree; prior data/statistics/sports experience. Analyze event and tracking data and prepare pre/post-match and opposition reports. About 15 hours/week for February–April 2027.
jobs.evidence_notes: Official careers page designates Greenhouse; Greenhouse detail includes application form. No application submitted.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.requirements: Quantitative degree or equivalent demonstrated experience; Python analysis, statistics/ML and visualization. Build reproducible workflows and recurring match reporting, answer sporting, scouting and recruitment questions.
jobs.evidence_notes: Current MLS index and full detail visible; Apply Now leads to TeamWork sign-in, so accepting applications beyond sign-in not verified. Club's own landing points to Dayforce, whose listing content was not readable.

jobs.title: Business Analyst Intern (Spring 2027)
jobs.requirements: Must be enrolled at an accredited institution and receive academic credit. Support dashboards, KPIs, data retrieval, Salesforce deduplication and daily data hygiene.
jobs.evidence_notes: Full detail and current MLS index visible; Apply Now present; application acceptance not independently confirmed.

jobs.title: Analyst, Lifecycle Marketing
jobs.requirements: Working knowledge of email/SMS platforms and audience segmentation. Monitor conversions, engagement and revenue; execute campaign tests and collaborate with business analytics.
jobs.evidence_notes: Current MLS index and full detail visible; role is marketing analytics adjacent and does not list Python/SQL.

jobs.title: First Team Performance Analyst
jobs.requirements: Support recording, tagging and video analysis; organize player performance/match statistics, maintain records and prepare opponent scouting reports. This is mainly a performance/video role.
jobs.evidence_notes: Official NYCFC careers page designates TeamWork. Current MLS index and full detail with Apply Now visible; no application submitted.

jobs.title: Senior Sport & Data Scientist
jobs.requirements: 4+ years in sport/data science or sports analytics; quantitative/sport-science degree. Integrate athlete monitoring and club data, maintain lakehouse pipelines and develop statistical/ML models and performance dashboards.
jobs.evidence_notes: Readable designated team index and detailed posting with Apply Now visible. Application acceptance not verified.

jobs.title: PART-TIME - Associate, Data Strategy
jobs.requirements: Pursuing or earned four-year degree; experience with presentations and visualization. Analyze data warehouse and Tableau reporting for pricing/inventory, fan segmentation and commercial insights.
jobs.evidence_notes: Current MLS collection and full detailed posting visible. At least two in-office days generally required; posting states work authorization without employer visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Data Analytics Intern
jobs.requirements: Current students, recent graduates or equivalent experience. Support ticket-pricing/forecasting reports, code review, dashboard tests, business KPIs and communication with ticket sales. About 20–25 hours/week, 2–3 office days.
jobs.evidence_notes: Current Angel City Greenhouse board and full application form retrieved; same role in current NWSL TeamWork index. No application submitted.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Insights & Analytics

summary.scope: US/Canada MLS and NWSL 2026 top-division club roster, 30 MLS + 16 NWSL. Not all sports teams globally. Snapshot of readable official pages/designated ATSs; dynamic, account-gated and unresolved team boards explicitly marked.
summary.no_false_completeness: Reviewed means the stated readable index/detail was inspected, not a guarantee of complete organizational vacancy coverage or ongoing acceptance. No negative vacancy conclusion for blocked/unreviewed pages. Sources were checked using the stated user-local date; postings can change.
excluded_leads: Sporting Kansas City data analyst, data engineer, data scientist: secondary-site leads from about two months before check, not verified current on official detail.
Boston Legacy older CRM/data analyst leads: not in readable current Rippling index.
Inter Miami Business Intelligence internships: secondary index leads; official detail not accessible.
League-office roles are separate employers, excluded from team job count.
Sports Scientist performance roles at Portland Thorns and Bay FC excluded from requested data-scientist title count.
summary.portfolio_signal: Common evidence across detailed jobs favors Python/SQL, reproducible ingestion, data quality, version control, temporal model validation, practical dashboards, and concise reports that answer a coaching or business decision.

dataset_recommendation.name: StatsBomb Open Data
dataset_recommendation.license: Custom StatsBomb Open Data User Agreement (LICENSE.pdf), not MIT/CC0.
dataset_recommendation.verified_terms: Official repository README invites research/public analysis and asks for StatsBomb source attribution and logo. Official Hudl blog states the standard license is noncommercial, for fan analysis and academic research.
dataset_recommendation.limitation: Exact PDF agreement could not be extracted: web rejects octet-stream and GitHub connector rejects binary/non-UTF8. Do not assert unrestricted raw-data redistribution. Prefer runtime downloads, ignore raw data in Git, show attribution/logo, keep source-code license separate, and inspect exact PDF before distributing underlying data.
dataset_recommendation.project_fit: Event JSON with shot xG supports Python/SQL ingestion, QA, match reports, opponent scouting and model calibration. Selected competitions/seasons only; not a comprehensive live MLS/NWSL feed.
